changes.text: Played the original NASFAQ? Link your old account from your profile, or at /link-v1. You get a v1 Veteran badge with the year you joined, a trophy on your profile with your v1 name, join date, peak net worth and rank, and the v1 Classic theme, which makes your profile page look like the old site. You confirm on nasfaq.biz, so this site never sees your old password. It works for v1 accounts made before October 1, 2026, one v1 account per player.
